ICS 73.020                         MED 08Reaffirmed 20221. ScopeThis standard specifies the requirements for mine tubs of capacity 1.2 m3 (Type ‘A’), 56.25 cft (Type ’B’), 67.5 cft (Type ‘C’), 0.68 m3 (Type ‘D’) and 2.4 m3 (Type ‘E’-GRANBY); Rail Gauge : 610mm.2. Referenced DocumentsThe following standards contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard.
